steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with App Name: Notes Keeper and Package Name: com.noteskeeper.app

steps.title: Setup Project Structure and Gradle Build
steps.description: Configure the root build.gradle with proper repository links and Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2.

steps.title: Configure Project Settings
steps.description: Create settings.gradle file to structure the modular project hierarchy and register the app module.

steps.title: Configure App-Level Build Script
steps.description: Define compile SDK, Target SDK, namespace, and package application ID in app/build.gradle adhering strictly to compileSdk 34.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Declare the system package, primary custom theme, launcher main activity, and custom drawable launcher icon references.

steps.title: Create Card Design Drawable
steps.description: Create rounded rectangle shapes for note-display container cards in drawable resource folder.

steps.title: Create Tag Design Drawable
steps.description: Design pill-styled tag shapes to beautifully present the dynamically assigned category name inside cards.

steps.title: Create Accent Button Drawable
steps.description: Define styled background XML to format full-width rounded primary action buttons at the bottom.

steps.title: Declare App Resources Strings
steps.description: Build localizable strings to configure names and titles across multiple displays and dialog views.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Prepare user interface containing a search bar, a dynamic category-filtering Spinner, and a notes ListView.

steps.title: Design Note Card Item Layout
steps.description: Implement standard list adapter layout with fields for title, body excerpt, date timestamp, category tag, and editing controls.

steps.title: Design Dynamic Note Create/Edit Dialog
steps.description: Establish interactive form layout with inputs for Title, Content text, and Category selection spinner.

steps.title: Design Category Creation Dialog
steps.description: Create small modular input form to dynamically expand classification categories.

steps.title: Model Note Object
steps.description: Write a pure Java note model class containing entity fields for DB representation: ID, Title, Content, Category, and Creation Timestamp.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Operations
steps.description: Incorporate SQLite helper architecture offering seamless tables setup and robust APIs for note additions, upgrades, filters, and deletions.

steps.title: Build Base List View Note Adapter
steps.description: Develop custom BaseAdapter mapping model parameters into structured note layouts and linking interaction triggers to MainActivity controls.

steps.title: Build Main Activity Flow and State Management
steps.description: Program initialization logic, UI mappings, spinner loaders, real-time search watchers, and click bindings.

steps.title: Incorporate Dialog Handling & Form Logic
steps.description: Bind interactive custom dialog popups handling form validation, additions, updates, and delete verification routines.

steps.title: Review Java 8 Syntax Compliance
steps.description: Inspect anonymous inner-class declarations ensuring zero lambda usages and maintaining robust older environment compilation.

steps.title: Building Notes Keeper
steps.description: Initiate automated build process compiling dependencies, layouts, assets, and source components into the final dynamic APK.
